$comment: Gate conformance fixture (Epic #1347 S2 / #1349). Feed the artifact to your host loop and assert the expectedHostAction. gate.inputs replays through src/lib/gate-decision.mjs deriveGateDecision. Note: observation.files derives from changedFiles, which is NOT echoed in gate.inputs — a replay reproduces decision/reasonCode/tier/inputsHash but not observation.files.
expectedHostAction: Proceed AND request an async human review. If the window expires unreviewed: stop the loop and treat observation.files changes as unreviewed (re-review required).
